title: TemporalFact
description: A retrieval-plane fact asserting that (entity, relation) holds a value over a validity interval. Facts are the search consumer's projection of the graph's three-time model: valid_from/valid_to correspond to node/edge valid_time.from/to and to the epistemic-edge temporalScope.validFrom/validTo. A fact carries an optional supersession marker (superseded_by pointer + superseded_at instant); the temporal retrieval filter suppresses superseded facts in a high-recall pass and, for a given (entity, relation), rates the maximum-valid_from surviving fact as authoritative. This record NEVER claims canonical truth; canonical supersession lives in the ACR decision ledger and epistemic-edge promotion state.

entity.description: Stable subject reference (e.g. canonical-entity entity_id or node_id).

relation.description: Relation/predicate name, e.g. HAS_CEO. The (entity, relation) pair is the supersession key.

value.description: Object of the relation at this validity interval, e.g. the CEO's name. Carried so retrieval yields an answer.

valid_from.description: Instant from which this fact is valid (valid-time). Required: a fact with no valid_from cannot be temporally ordered and is rejected.

valid_to.description: Instant after which this fact stops being valid, or null for open-ended. When present, must be >= valid_from.

superseded_by.description: fact_id of the fact that replaces this one for the same (entity, relation). Presence marks this fact superseded; the retrieval filter excludes it.

superseded_at.description: Instant at which this fact was marked superseded. Presence marks this fact superseded. When present, must be >= valid_from.

source_edge_ref.description: Optional upstream edge_id / epistemic-edge recordId this fact was projected from.

claims_canonical_truth.description: Retrieval-plane facts never claim canonical truth; canonical supersession is owned by ACR / epistemic-edge promotion.

ledger_refs.description: Optional ACR decision-ledger entries backing the supersession decision.
